uncited: Chunk Lifecycle Management is the core algorithm for maintaining the set of active volume data chunks in memory during streaming.
**Identify Desired Region:** Compute the set of all chunk positions within the render distance from the camera.
**Identify Existing Region:** Extract the set of positions currently held in the `chunks` hash map.
For each position $p \in P_{existing}$, if $p \notin P_{nearby}$, the chunk is no longer needed.
-   Remove the chunk object from the `chunks` map.
-   Remove the chunk from frame draw calls.
For each position $p \in P_{nearby}$, if $p \notin P_{existing}$, the chunk is missing.
-   Insert the new object into the `chunks` map with key $p$.
-   **Time Complexity:** $O(N + M)$, where $N$ is the number of chunks in the render distance and $M$ is the number of currently loaded chunks.
-   **Memory Complexity:** Proportional to the number of loaded chunks.
